Written by audit_batch.py import-reads; read only through lineage_reads.load, the one normalization.

read.probe-layout: sources in src/<name>.cob, run with probe.sh at --std 2002 and 2023; each run's output in run/<name>.<std>/log.txt; conformance cases re-run with runcases.sh into run/<case>.2002/
clause-findings: FORMAT ORDER (render of §2002 PDF page 580 = printed 558, probes-q-35/pages/spec_p580.png): 2002 Format 1 prints the AT END-OF-PAGE / NOT AT END-OF-PAGE phrases BEFORE [retry-phrase] and [WITH LOCK | WITH NO LOCK]; 2014 and 2023 print them AFTER. At --std 2002 the compiler accepts only the 2014/2023 order: `WRITE P-REC AFTER ADVANCING 1 LINE AT END-OF-PAGE ADD 1 TO N NOT AT END-OF-PAGE ADD 2 TO N WITH LOCK END-WRITE` on a LINAGE file with LOCK MODE MANUAL is refused 'error COBOL2269: unexpected WITH. The ADD statement ends before this token' (src/ord2002.cob), and `AT EOP ADD 3 TO N RETRY 2 TIMES WITH NO LOCK` is refused 'error COBOL0901: RETRY is a reserved word ... cannot be used as a user-defined word' (src/ord2002b.cob); the 2023 order compiles and runs at --std 2002 (src/ord2023.cob, N=2). DEFECT: legal 2002 source refused.

OPTIONAL STATUS: in 2002 the only optional element is Annex A, communications (§2002:3.1); WRITE FILE (2023 A.4.13) and the FORMAT clause (2023 A.4.8) are REQUIRED in 2002, and the compiler declines both at --std 2002 (COBOL1706 src/wfile.cob, COBOL1705 src/fmtw.cob). Same root as the p-12 and p-14 findings (2002-SR-13.3.5.2-4).
